source.title: Optional upstream API supply: original outputs, model costs and evaluation support
source.body:
Hi APIDot team — I’m Yami from ToAPIs. This is a supplier-cooperation proposal, not a bug report.

APIDot runs a multimodal API platform with common submission, task polling and webhook examples. We prepared original outputs, exact parameters and a dated price sheet for an optional upstream evaluation:
https://github.com/ToAPIs-2025/lower-cost-apidot-upstream-toapis

Our international test Key currently quotes gpt-image-2 / 1K at $0.015/image and gpt-image-2.5-flare / 1K at $0.0225/image. Both amounts were confirmed by settled image receipts on October 29. Seedance 2.5 / 720p / one first frame / 4s requested / audio off settled at $0.873 for a decoded 4.04s clip (about $0.216089/s for that example; Key quote $10/1M total tokens). The quotations were checked on October 30; the original settled media are reused October 29 examples, not native acceptance in your product or universal tariffs.

We can support an optional Provider with evaluation credits and hands-on parameter/debugging help, product/documentation sponsorship where useful, or supplementary upstream API supply for your own hosted service. Larger-volume terms can be discussed against your exact models, output specifications and expected demand. Your branding, customer billing and existing suppliers can stay in place.

We recognize that public starting prices can refer to different quality/channels. We are not claiming to undercut your current procurement rate; the guide gives exact test-Key specifications so your team can assess a suitable capacity or model gap.

Would the person responsible for image/video model sourcing be open to reviewing these options? We can follow your supplier process and support a test that addresses an actual requirement from your team.

Thank you,
YamiAnn — ToAPIs Team
yami@toapis.com
